problem_statement: Enforce argument validation in Kokkos::TeamPolicy constructors for both execution-space and default-space overloads. For explicit integer arguments, require league_size to be non-negative, team_size and vector_length to be at least one, and—unless KOKKOS_ENABLE_DEPRECATED_CODE_5 is defined—vector_length to not exceed TeamPolicy::vector_length_max(). Arguments specified as Kokkos::AUTO must be excluded from numeric bounds checks. Any violation must trigger Kokkos::abort.
title: Enforce TeamPolicy constructor preconditions
